name: Productivity Coach Demo | Read Plan Tree

parameters.content:
## Productivity Coach Demo | Read Plan Tree

One read of the plan, shared by two agents so both see the same picture: projects → their weekly goals → daily tasks, with the links between them. A project holds the outcome; its weekly goals hold how it is done.
Called by "Productivity Agent" and "Projects Coach" (locked to them) before each agent answers. No AI, no writes.
Errors go to "Error Handling | Main — Error Handler".

## Read Plan Tree

Triggered by: Receive Tree Call (from "Productivity Agent" or "Projects Coach").

1. Fetch Projects: every project not Done or Killed.
2. Fetch Weekly Plan: open weekly items, everything due from last Monday on (last week's unscored goals feed a late review), and goals of the last 12 weeks that have a Result (for the Coach's calibration only).
3. Fetch Tasks: open daily tasks and every task due this week or next.
4. Build Plan Tree (also compares names and project statuses with what each agent saw last time, by Notion page id, kept in this workflow's static data; a change becomes memory_note, which the agent writes into its chat memory): puts goals under their project and counts their tasks; one text block both agents print as is, plus the rows as data.
